usage: The verb 寫 means 'to write' and is used when you want to describe the act of writing with a pen, pencil, or typing on a keyboard.
You can use 寫 before the object you are writing, like a letter, an email, or your name.
In Cantonese, 寫 can be combined with other words to form phrases like 寫信 (write a letter) or 寫功課 (do homework).
The verb 寫 often appears with time words to indicate when the writing happens, such as 今日寫 (write today) or 而家寫 (write now).
